name: HTTP Request Smuggling - Desync / Embedded Request (CWE-444)
description: Detects HTTP request-smuggling artefacts: a second HTTP request line pipelined inside the body (the CL.TE/TE.CL desync payload) or an obfuscated Transfer-Encoding token. Pairs with the first-class `smuggling` stage, which rejects Content-Length/Transfer-Encoding header ambiguity that a single-target signature cannot express.
